text: Fodor argues that the fact that anyone who can think JOHN LOVES MARY can also think MARY LOVES JOHN illustrates the ___ of thought, which he takes to require a combinatorial representational medium.
explanation: Systematicity is the fact that the capacity to think certain thoughts comes in packages: anyone able to think JOHN LOVES MARY can think MARY LOVES JOHN, because the thoughts share recombinable constituents. Fodor distinguishes this from productivity (the sheer unboundedness of thinkable thoughts); the expected term is 'systematicity'.
